import pandas as pd
import re

file_path = '/data/seva_invoice_register_uncalculated.xlsx'
df_raw = pd.read_excel(file_path, sheet_name='Invoice Register', header=None)

header_idx = 3
cols = df_raw.iloc[header_idx].tolist()
df_raw.columns = cols
data_start = header_idx + 2
df = df_raw.iloc[data_start:].copy()

# Clean column names strip
df.columns = [str(c).strip() for c in df.columns]

# Filter rows where Invoice ID matches pattern SEVA-
pattern = r'^SEVA-\d{2}-\d{4}$'
mask_invoice = df['Invoice ID'].astype(str).str.match(pattern, na=False)
mask_qty = pd.to_numeric(df['Quantity'], errors='coerce').notna()
mask_rate = pd.to_numeric(df['Unit Rate (INR)'], errors='coerce').notna()
mask = mask_invoice & mask_qty & mask_rate

df_clean = df[mask].copy()
print('Rows kept', len(df_clean))
print(df_clean[['Invoice ID','Quantity','Unit Rate (INR)','District']].head())

# Compute Line Amount
df_clean['Quantity_num'] = pd.to_numeric(df_clean['Quantity'], errors='coerce')
df_clean['UnitRate_num'] = pd.to_numeric(df_clean['Unit Rate (INR)'], errors='coerce')
df_clean['LineAmount'] = df_clean['Quantity_num'] * df_clean['UnitRate_num']

# Check for any non-numeric district
print(df_clean['District'].isna().sum())

# Aggregate by district
agg = df_clean.groupby('District')['LineAmount'].sum().sort_values(ascending=False)
print(agg.head(20))
print('Total invoices', len(df_clean))
